*** Add File: synthesize_ssml.py
+import base64
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+def synthesize_ssml(ssml: str, voice_name: str, speaking_rate: float = 1.0, pitch: str = "0st") -> bytes:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS is required for Google Cloud Text-to-Speech")
+    endpoint = "https://texttospeech.googleapis.com/v1/text:synthesize"
+    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
+        "input": {"ssml": ssml},
+        "voice": {"languageCode": "en-US", "name": voice_name},
+        "audioConfig": {"audioEncoding": "MP3", "speakingRate": speaking_rate, "pitch": pitch},
+    }
+    response = requests.post(endpoint, json=payload, timeout=60)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    audio_content = response.json()["audioContent"]
+    return base64.b64decode(audio_content)
+
*** End Patch

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: synthesize_text.py
+import os
+from typing import Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_TTS_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/speech"
+OPENAI_TTS_MODEL = "gpt-4o-mini-tts"
+
+
+def synthesize_text(text: str, voice: str = "alloy", model: str = OPENAI_TTS_MODEL, format: str = "mp3", speed: Optional[float] = None) -> bytes:
+    payload = {"model": model, "input": text, "voice": voice, "format": format}
+    if speed is not None:
+        payload["speed"] = speed
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_TTS_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['OPENAI_API_KEY']}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=120,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.content
+
*** End Patch
